dct_description_sm: Beaver Creek is an experimental road site where mitigation techniques, aiming to control permafrost degradation along the Alaska Highway, are being tested since implementation in summer 2008. The site comprises 12 sub-sections including a control sub-section.  Surface temperature sensors have been installed in various locations at the Beaver Creek test site in order to conduct a fine-scale temperature analysis of the mitigation technique efficiency.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Roads
dct_title_s: Surface temperature at Beaver Creek experimental site
